defs.def: happening or done quickly and unexpectedly 突然的；忽然的；骤然的noun

ex.s: Suddenly it occurred to me that he did not even know how to use a dictionary.
ex.t: 我突然意识到，他甚至不知道怎么用词典。

ex.s: Bent over my laptop while sitting on the bed in the corner of my room, I suddenly felt a pounding headache, and had to lie down.
ex.t: 我弓着背坐在房间角落的床上盯着笔记本电脑，突然感到一阵剧烈的头痛，不得不躺下。

ex.s: And then all of a sudden it clicks.”
ex.t: 然后突然间，一切就豁然开朗了。

ex.s: Suddenly, a movement outside caught his eye.
ex.t: 突然，外面的一阵动静引起了他的注意。

ex.s: Suddenly, the man jumped through an open window into the house.
ex.t: 突然，那名男子从一扇开着的窗户跳进屋里。

ex.s: Suddenly I was locked outside.
ex.t: 突然我被锁在了外面。

ex.s: “Impetuous has two definitions: rushing with great force or violence; acting suddenly, with little thought. ”
ex.t: “Impetuous有两个释义：以巨大的力量或暴力冲撞；突然行动，欠思考。”

ex.s: So, why did he suddenly force me to do something at which I was sure to fail?
ex.t: 那么，他为什么突然强迫我去做一件我肯定会失败的事呢？

ex.s: So, why did he suddenly force me to do something at which I was sure to fail?
ex.t: 那么，他为什么突然强迫我去做一件我肯定会失败的事呢？

ex.s: If TMS is applied to a specific part of your brain behind your forehead that is particularly important for decision-making, you suddenly like different kinds of art.
ex.t: 如果TMS被应用到你前额后面的某个特定的大脑部分，对于决策特别重要，那么你突然喜欢不同的艺术。

ex.s: An idea suddenly crossed Cruse's mind.
ex.t: 克鲁斯突然想到一个主意。

ex.s: It suddenly became very clear to me how lucky I was to be fluent in two languages.
ex.t: 我突然非常清楚地意识到我能流利地说两种语言是多么幸运。

ex.s: Three days ago, the light in our living room suddenly went out.
ex.t: 三天前客厅的灯突然灭了。

ex.s: For some moments, John said nothing, but, suddenly, he sprang to his feet and cried, “I have a great idea!
ex.t: 约翰沉默了片刻，但忽然一跃而起，喊道：“我有个好主意！”

ex.s: Or perhaps a design works so well it is adopted elsewhere again and again, with seemingly harmless improvements, until, suddenly, it does not work at all anymore.
ex.t: 或者也许一个设计如此出色，以至于被其他地方反复采用，并进行了看似无害的改进，直到突然它完全不起作用了。

ex.s: For some moments, John said nothing, but, suddenly, he sprang to his feet and cried, “I have a great idea!
ex.t: 约翰沉默了片刻，但忽然一跃而起，喊道：“我有个好主意！”

ex.s: And then, one day I was at a big conference and it suddenly hit me like lightning.
ex.t: 然后有一天，我在一个大型会议上，它突然像闪电一样击中了我。

ex.s: Suddenly football feel just in front of me but almost hit me.
ex.t: 突然一个足球掉在我面前，差点砸到我。

ex.s: “The living-room television is replaced and gets planted in the kids’ room, and suddenly one day, you have a TV in every room of the house,” said one researcher.
ex.t: “客厅的电视被替换下来，装进了孩子的房间，于是一天，你突然发现家里每个房间都有一台电视了，”一位研究者说。

ex.s: I suddenly found myself out of class before noon time.
ex.t: 然后我到了不得不熬到深夜才能独自完成作业的地步。

ex.s: It was a relief and I came to a suddenly stop just in the middle on the road.
ex.t: 这是一个解脱，我来到一个突然停止 就在中间的道路。

ex.s: After driving in vain for some time, Mom suddenly got a great idea: Why didn’t we find a house with a likely-looking backyard and ask if we could set up tent there?
ex.t: 徒劳地开了一阵后，妈妈突然有了个好主意：我们为什么不找一户后院看起来合适的房子，问问能不能在那里搭帐篷？

ex.s: In southern Spain the sudden increase of greenhouses (which reflect light back to space) has changed the warming trend locally, and actually cooled the region.
ex.t: 在西班牙南部，温室（将光线反射回太空）的突然增加已经改变了当地的变暖趋势，实际上使该地区降温了。

ex.s: Suddenly, Paris fell to the ground, “Paris’s eye rolled back,” Taylor says.
ex.t: 突然，帕里斯倒在地上，“帕里斯的眼睛翻了过去，”泰勒说。

ex.s: Paris had suffered a sudden heart failure.
ex.t: 巴黎曾突发心力衰竭。

ex.s: Experts say Paris is right: For a sudden heart failure, the single best chance for survival is having someone nearby step in and do CPR quickly.
ex.t: 专家们说巴黎的做法是对的：对于突发性心脏骤停，唯一的最佳生存机会是有人就近挺身而出并迅速实施心肺复苏术。

ex.s: She had a sudden heart problem.
ex.t: 她突发心脏问题。

ex.s: Suddenly, a girl bumped into me - the same girl from the corridor!
ex.t: 突然，一个女孩撞到了我——就是走廊里的那个女孩！

ex.s: While I was concentrating on photographing this amazing scene, I suddenly had a feeling that I was being watched.
ex.t: 当我专注于拍摄这个令人惊叹的场景时，我突然觉得自己被监视了。

ex.s: I was focusing on taking photos of the beautiful view, but suddenly I felt that someone or something was watching me.
ex.t: 我正专注于拍摄美丽的风景，但突然我感觉有什么人或什么东西在看着我。

ex.s: Suddenly a white rabbit with pink eyes ran by.
ex.t: 突然，一只粉色眼睛的白兔跑了过去。

ex.s: While the lights were changing to red, a car suddenly appeared round the corner.
ex.t: 当灯光变成红色的时候，一辆车突然出现在拐角处。
